title: Granting the Strongest Objection
goal: Grant the other side's best point with si bien, aun cuando or por más que, and still state your position.

items: I can grant an objection with *si bien*, *aun cuando* or *por más que* and still state my position.
I can choose the indicative or the subjunctive in the concession by whether the objection is a fact or open.
I can name the other side's concern with *ciertamente*, *legítimo*, *fundado* and *dar la razón*.
